title: Chapter 3: Torii-Moon Mirror Road — Hazard Layer
purpose: Rebuild this chapter as the hazard layer band of Torii-Moon Mirror Road
Use The Torii-Moon Gate state: Distortion Gate with ritual rerouting
Teach purification rites, mirror-reading, foxfire deception, taboo-aware movement
